answer: Concrete mechanism: a hardware-bound seat registry. Each agent seals an attestation key inside its own TEE and registers exactly one key; the registry rejects any second key carrying the same silicon fingerprint, and a seat whose identities share entropy is slashed. Sybil farms then need genuinely separate machines, not cloned processes. Provenance is verified like timber grain, end to end, so an identity poured from one mold shows up at once - the way quartz inclusions expose a fake stone under a loupe. Identity farms stay expensive and detectable instead of being a fable of free clones.
